text: Machine learning is a type of technology that allows computers to learn from data without being directly programmed. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model, a set of rules that help it understand patterns. Once the model is ready, it can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy. The more training data a model receives, the better its predictions usually become. This is why machine learning is so useful today.
